annotations.title: List the sources the answers cite

description: Which sites and pages the AI answers cite, and whose they are: one row per domain, most-cited first, with its most-cited pages. Use it to see what the engines read for the brand's questions, or for one question (pass a promptGroupId, or a finding's subjectRef). kind says whose a domain is: yours, a competitor's, or a third party (review_directory, forum, wikipedia, video, editorial). rate is the share of answers citing it with its 95% interval; state insufficient_data is not zero, never report it as a number. answers.citingAny is how many answers cite anything at all: where few do (ChatGPT often cites nothing), a share means less. yourAnswers counts answers citing your own pages there, or videos on your named YouTube channel. findings lists the live findings about a source.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

engine.description: Only this engine's answers. google_aio = Google AI Overviews; google_ai_mode = Google AI Mode; chatgpt = ChatGPT.

promptGroupId.description: Only the answers to this prompt: a promptGroupId from shruwd_list_prompts, or a finding's subjectRef.
